title: Dedicated audio models work in Play
summary:
Seven community projects joined the catalog, while Play fixed dedicated audio generation and the dashboard made keys and balances easier to read.

Play now sends prompts for dedicated audio models such as elevenmusic and elevenlabs to the speech endpoint, including a selected voice when provided. Text models that produce audio still use chat completions.

The catalog added OrchidLLM for multimodal generation, an OpenCode configuration CLI, TranslateIt, Tofu terminal chat, Storymake short-form video, and the chat apps Apiction and visiona. The Greenhouse count reached 681.

The balance gauge now keeps Pollen pack and tier labels visible. Users without keys see a prompt to create one, along with an explanation of API Keys versus App Keys.
